## Summary

Implements issue #101: seeds the three Inbox pipeline databases that issue #24's ten hardcoded databases deliberately excluded.

- **`inbox`**: mandatory user-owned `date`/`time`, user-owned `text`, nullable user-owned relation `type` → Inbox item types, and a system-owned relation `journalDay` resolved lazily at write time through the existing `getOrCreateJournalItem` mechanism (`backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxStore.ts`'s new `createInboxItemWithClient`, which also rejects a missing `date`/`time` and never overwrites client-supplied values).
- **`inboxItemTypes`**: baseline `name`/`emoji`/`status` (active/archived) schema — `processingMethod`/`targetDatabase` are issue #102's job.
- **`processingProposals`**: `kind`, nullable `sourceInbox`/`sourceTranscript`, `fingerprint`, `proposal`/`history` (introduced a new `"json"` `PropertyType` for these structured values), `status`, and nullable `resultItemId`/`resultLabel`, matching the issue's spec exactly.
- Added `backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxTypesStore.ts`'s `listActiveInboxTypes`, the data-layer function backing the future `GET /api/inbox-types` (`{ id, emoji, label }`, id-based, never emoji) — there is no HTTP server package in this repo yet to mount an actual route on, consistent with every other module in this codebase.
- Wired into `seedSystem.ts` after the ten databases and the Semprec project, following the same idempotency guard as the rest of the seed.
- Updated `smoke.test.ts`'s exact-database-list assertion to include the three new databases.
- Added `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/inboxPipeline.test.ts` covering schema shape, idempotency, missing-date/time rejection, verbatim date/time preservation, lazy/idempotent journalDay resolution, type-less item creation, emoji-rename-safe relations, and the active-types listing.

Full `backend/packages/data` test suite: **232/232 passing** (16 files), and `pnpm -r run build` is clean.
